responsibility: This header declares the full public interface to the mc front end's declaration and AST subsystem. It introduces the opaque decl_node handle and exports the broad API for module and scope lookup, symbol and type access, node construction and classification, statement and expression building, attribute setting, traversal state, language selection, and final output generation that all parser passes and support modules use to build and consume the compiler's internal tree.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public, opaque interface to the decl subsystem for other mc-boot modules. Unlike Gdecl.cc, it does not define node layouts or implement AST construction, lookup, or output routines; it only exposes the decl_node type and exported entry points.
